zh: 删得越多，剩下的串越短，target只可能从子序列变成不是子序列，不会反过来；所以“前t次删除后仍是子序列”对t单调，可以二分最大的t。
记录每个位置在第几步被删除（when[i]）。检查某个t时，只保留when[i]>t的位置即可，不需要真的去删除字符。
二分t∈[0,|source|]：检查时从左到右扫描未删除的位置，用贪心双指针匹配target（字符相等就推进target指针，全部匹配即可行）；可行则lo=mid，否则hi=mid−1，输出lo。比较区分大小写。
en: Deleting more only makes the remaining string shorter, so target can only stop being a subsequence, never become one again; whether target survives the first t deletions is monotone in t, and the largest t can be binary searched.
Record the step at which each position is deleted (when[i]). To test some t, just keep the positions with when[i] > t instead of actually deleting characters.

Binary search t in [0, |source|]: scan the kept positions left to right and greedily match target with two pointers (advance in target on equal characters; matching all of it means feasible); set lo = mid when feasible, otherwise hi = mid - 1, and print lo. Comparisons are case-sensitive.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Record the deletion time of each position and binary search on the number of deletions. When checking a candidate, ignore positions whose deletion time is <= the candidate, and greedily match the target subsequence.

## Correctness

The greedy always takes the earliest available matching position, which leaves the most positions for later characters, so it decides the subsequence question exactly. Extra deletions cannot create a new subsequence, so the feasible deletion counts form a prefix, and binary search finds the last feasible value.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
